CreateAttachmentUploadRequest.description: Request a presigned POST for an image attachment. The server enforces type and size via POST conditions.

size.description: Declared size in bytes, 10 MB max.

PresignedUpload.description: Presigned S3 POST. The browser submits a multipart/form-data POST to `url` with these fields plus the file.

url.description: S3 bucket endpoint to POST the form to.

fields.description: Form fields that must be sent exactly as provided (key, policy, signature, content-length-range, content-type conditions).
